name: Nanuku Resort Fiji
positioning: Secluded coastal resort on the southern coast of Viti Levu at Pacific Harbour, with suites, villas and private residences and a long list of outdoor adventures
best_for: Active travelers who want rafting, snorkeling, surfing and shark diving
Guests drawn to outdoor wellness such as sunrise yoga and massages in a Dilo tree
Travelers who want to help with coral reef and mangrove restoration

facts.text: Nanuku sits on the southern coast of Viti Levu, Fiji's largest island.
The resort's address is 11 Nanuku Drive in Pacific Harbour, Fiji.
Accommodation includes suites, villas and private residences.
Wellness options include sunrise yoga, high-energy workout classes and hikes.
Guests can hunt for crabs in dense mangrove forest and trek up sand dunes.
Guests can snorkel Beqa Lagoon, paddle board or hike to a waterfall.
Activities include zip-lining, surfing and cage-less bull shark diving.
Nanuku has a private island, used for half-day excursions for couples on a special offer.
The restaurant serves fresh seafood caught in Beqa Lagoon and South Pacific specialties such as ivi chestnuts and peach palm hearts.
Travel + Leisure readers voted Nanuku the number 2 resort in the South Pacific in its 2024 Readers' Choice Awards.

highlights.text: Massages are offered among the branches of a 70-year-old Dilo tree.
Guests can help rehabilitate Nanuku's private coral reef by planting coral and mangroves with the resort's marine biologist.
Guests can whitewater raft through black volcanic walls barely five meters apart.
The largest residences have private plunge pools and elevated balconies that overlook the ocean.
The suites have vaulted thatched roofs and private terraces.

considerations.text: Nanuku is on the southern coast of Viti Levu, Fiji's largest island, at Pacific Harbour, rather than on a small outer island.
WhataHotel notes limited nightlife and entertainment options.
